sections.position: Software Engineer working across full-stack web development, systems, and IoT.

profile.intro: Software Engineer building reliable products across web and systems.
profile.background: Based in Barcelona, I work across frontend, backend, and systems programming. My training at 42 Barcelona and Ironhack gave me a practical foundation built around real projects and problem solving.
profile.current: I combine React and Node.js development with C/C++, Linux, networking, Docker, and IoT work.
profile.skills: I care about clear code, sensible architecture, and building software that is easy to test, use, and maintain.
profile.collaboration: I work comfortably in collaborative teams, contribute through pull requests and reviews, and communicate clearly across technical and product discussions.
profile.future: I am continuing to deepen my understanding of software design, distributed systems, and long-term product ownership.
profile.goal: Open to projects where thoughtful engineering and useful products matter.
